response.overview: A story about growing up, losing people, and trying to hold onto the moments that make life worth remembering.  Made over the course of a year by an 18-year-old filmmaker, this film blurs the line between fiction and reality. Written, directed, shot, and edited by one person, with friends and family stepping in front of the camera, it became something much more personal than a film about high school.  In many ways, the people making the film were living through their own versions of the story. What began as an attempt to capture a fleeting period of life became an experience of its own.  An imperfect, deeply personal film about friendship, loss, growing up, and the things we don’t realize we’re going to miss until they’re gone.
response.tagline: A film about life, made while living it.
response.title: My Life is a Movie
